name: excellent-reference
description: Answers about Excellent, the platform for restaurant groups' private dining, events, staff training and marketing. No account needed.

interface.longDescription:
Ask ChatGPT how Excellent works and get the answer from Excellent's own help text: proposals and e-signed contracts, deposit schedules and invoices, banquet event orders, floor plans, staff training, marketing drafts and connecting an AI assistant. Search Excellent's published feature pages, its comparisons with other private-dining platforms (each with where the other product wins and when it was last reviewed), and its blog.

For diners planning a private event: ChatGPT can list the venues that chose to take private-event inquiries from AI assistants, and, only when you ask, send one of them your inquiry with the name and email or phone you give. It lands as a lead the venue's team reviews and answers itself; nothing is booked, held or paid.

No sign-in and no restaurant group's data. ChatGPT can also start a sample workspace you can claim and explore. To work with your own events, leads, invoices and drafts, connect the Excellent plugin instead. Docs: beexcellent.ai/mcp.
defaultPrompt: How does Excellent handle deposit schedules for private events?
What does Excellent do that Tripleseat doesn't, and where does Tripleseat win?
Can Excellent generate a banquet event order from a signed proposal?

prompts: How does Excellent handle deposit schedules for private events?
What does Excellent do that Tripleseat doesn't, and where does Tripleseat win?
Can Excellent generate a banquet event order from a signed proposal?

positive.description: Setup: none — no sign-in; every tool works without an account. Ask how deposits work, answered from Excellent's own help text.
positive.prompt: How does Excellent handle deposit schedules for private events?
positive.expected_behavior: Says deposits are set once for the whole restaurant group, as a percentage of the invoice by party size (by default 25% up to 20 guests, 30% for 21 to 50, 40% for 51 to 100 and 50% over 100), and that payment timing is set per invoice as installments, for example a deposit at booking and the balance before the event, with reminders as installments come due.

positive.description: Setup: none — no sign-in; every tool works without an account. Compare Excellent with Tripleseat, including where Tripleseat is stronger.
positive.prompt: What does Excellent do that Tripleseat doesn't, and where does Tripleseat win?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes Excellent's own Excellent-vs-Tripleseat comparison. Where Tripleseat wins includes its larger install base and partner ecosystem, such as the EventUp marketplace, and hotel features such as group room blocks and PMS integrations. Where Excellent wins includes running a multi-location group from one setup, AI-drafted proposals and BEOs for a person to review, events and staff training on one platform, and a hard block on double-bookings. ChatGPT may add sources of its own.

positive.description: Setup: none — no sign-in; every tool works without an account. Ask whether a banquet event order can be generated, answered from the help text and feature pages.
positive.prompt: Can Excellent generate a banquet event order from a signed proposal?
positive.expected_behavior: Says yes: on an event's page in Excellent, Generate BEO builds the banquet event order from the event's own details, with views for the kitchen, the floor and the guest, in English or Spanish.

positive.description: Setup: none — no sign-in; every tool works without an account. Ask which venues take private-event inquiries through an AI assistant. Only venues that opted in are listed, so the answer may be that none match.
positive.prompt: Which venues named Lumière take private-event inquiries through ChatGPT?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches Excellent's venues that accept inquiries from AI assistants. If any match, it lists each with its restaurant group and who replies, and offers to send an inquiry only if the person asks. If none match, it says so and that this does not mean the venue doesn't host private events. It invents no venues and sends nothing.

positive.description: Setup: none — no sign-in; every tool works without an account. Ask to try Excellent with sample data. This tool creates a sample workspace and may be called at most 3 times a day per address, so run it once.
positive.prompt: I'd like to try Excellent with sample data. Can you set up a workspace for me?
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a sample workspace and returns a one-time link for the person to claim it, which expires after 7 days if unused. It says the workspace holds a fictional restaurant group with sample data, that nothing is emailed or texted, and it asks for no personal details.

negative.description: General question about running events that is not about Excellent. Answers from general knowledge and calls no Excellent tool.
negative.prompt: How far in advance should a restaurant ask for the final headcount on a private dinner?

negative.description: Asks for text written in the chat, not a lookup of Excellent's help or pages. Writes the text in the chat and calls no Excellent tool.
negative.prompt: Write a polite email to a guest explaining that the balance for their party is due a week before the event.

negative.description: General market research on other products, not a question about Excellent. Gives a general overview (it may search the web) and calls no Excellent tool.
negative.prompt: What do restaurant groups usually look for when choosing event management software?

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold or paid for inside ChatGPT, and this free server has no payment tools. It only answers questions about Excellent and can start a free sample workspace.

publication.release_notes: First release of Excellent Reference for ChatGPT.
